overcharge.textTemplate: Your hits build Arcane Exposure faster.

progression-cinderbound-crown.textTemplate: Your first credited kill of an enemy with Bleed buildup each combat heals {heal} HP.

progression-cracked-war-anvil.textTemplate: Your first Heavy attack each turn deals {poiseDamage} additional Break damage.

progression-ember-alms-bowl.textTemplate: Your first nonlethal HP offering each turn grants {block} Block after its payment.

progression-emberjaw-token.textTemplate: Your first Blade hit each combat applies {bleed} additional Bleed buildup.

progression-fragment-of-the-third-sky.textTemplate: Your third distinct Starstone card ID played in a turn grants {block} Block, once per turn.

progression-moonwell-lens.textTemplate: Your first Starstone spell each turn played after spending at least 2 Mana grants {block} Block.

progression-nightglass-rosary.textTemplate: The second play of the same Starstone card ID in a turn restores {restoreMana} Mana, once per turn.

progression-ossuary-prayer-wheel.textTemplate: Your first credited kill of an enemy with Crimson or Necrotic Blight buildup each combat restores {restoreMana} Mana.

progression-purse-of-borrowed-shadows.textTemplate: After your first explicit discard each turn, gain {block} Block.

progression-whisperglass-die.textTemplate: If your first card in combat is a Blade attack, it deals +{chargeDamage} damage.

resonance.textTemplate: Breaking a foe's Arcane Exposure builds {spreadPct}% of its threshold on every other foe.

siphon.textTemplate: Breaking a foe's Arcane Exposure restores {restoreMana} Mana, or {restoreMana.2} once your focus skill is mastered.

staggerBreak.textTemplate: Breaking a foe's Arcane Exposure deals {poiseDamage} Poise damage to it.

throw.textTemplate: Choose Throw to attack one extra band with the configured Precision penalty; retain the weapon.

unarmed.flavor:
Blow of the empty fist.

The last thing a Forsaken owns once the blade is broken and the cairn has kept it. No hamlet teaches it; it is learned the first winter a sword is traded for salt.

A last resort, still yours.
